_note: Season windows by local month-day (from..to, inclusive; from > to wraps the new year). First match wins, so the order is the priority: Undas, New Year, Christmas, heat, rainy season. Every line comes from the named source (checked on the date). No doses, no diagnosis.

seasons.title: Undas
lines: Drink water often, and take breaks out of the sun.
Agree on a meeting spot before you go in with a crowd.

seasons.title: New Year fireworks
lines: Burned by a firecracker? Cool it under cool running water, about 20 minutes.
Do not put ice, oil, butter or toothpaste on a burn.
Get help right away for a deep burn, or a burn on the face, hands or feet.

seasons.title: Christmas food
lines: Salt adds up fast at the party table.
Adults are advised to keep to less than 5 grams of salt a day.

seasons.title: Hot season
lines: Limit your time in the heat.
Some medicines make heat harder on the body. Ask your pharmacist.

seasons.title: Rainy and typhoon season
lines: Have a plan for floods and storms.
Check the storm alerts in Safety.
